candidates.tagline: FIFA picked a stadium stranded in NJ swampland for the World Cup Final
candidates.story: The 2026 FIFA World Cup Final is at MetLife Stadium on July 19 — an 80,000-seat venue in the New Jersey Meadowlands completely surrounded by highway ramps and parking lots, with no direct subway from New York City, forcing fans to pay $98 for a two-train transfer or $225 to park near the American Dream mall.
candidates.why_funny: FIFA sold 80,000 tickets to the world's biggest soccer event at America's most car-dependent stadium, then told everyone there was no parking and to take a bus — in New Jersey.
candidates.alt: Aerial view of MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey, showing the arena completely encircled by parking lots and highway access ramps with no rail line or pedestrian approach visible

candidates.tagline: Japan's 'last human social network' beat AI by closing in 6 months
candidates.story: POPOPO — launched March 2026, backed by 4chan founder Hiroyuki, Evangelion director Hideaki Anno, and musician GACKT as 'the last human-made social network in the AI era' — announced its shutdown on July 15, 2026, only six months after launch, with the team stating 'we failed spectacularly.'
candidates.why_funny: They declared war on AI with 'the last human social network,' then built an app where humans communicate exclusively through anime avatars called Holosuits, and it still collapsed in half a year.
candidates.alt: Official POPOPO app promotional image showing two anime-style 3D avatar characters standing next to smartphones displaying video call screens, surrounded by floating cartoon mascots — a cat, panda, bear with a crown, and robot — against a bright blue background, with the POPOPO logo and Japanese text reading 'video calling without a camera'
